title: Madhya-khanda, part 10 (portion 33)
html:
The section "The Leper's Release from Sin and the Bhava of Baladeva" (end): a brahmana who was not admitted to see the Lord's dancing curses Him — "Be outside samsara!" — and the Lord accepts the curse as a blessing. The section "Shachi's Grief over the Brahmana's Curse" (only in the 1983 edition): Shachi in despair, the Lord consoles her. The section "Mahaprabhu Distributes Prema in His Bhavas": the Lord in the bhava of Balarama demands honey; the vision of Halayudha and His words to Gadadhara; the fragrance of varuni and Balarama's divine companions; the Lord tells of Varaha and Halayudha and asks for His flute

তবে আর-একদিন প্রভু নৃত্য করে ।
আছিল ত একজন ব্রাহ্মণ দুয়ারে ॥ ৪৫ ॥

tabe āra-ekadina prabhu nṛtya kare |
āchila ta ekajana brāhmaṇa duẏāre || 45 ||

tabe ara-ekadina — then on another day; prabhu nritya kare — the Lord dances; achhila ta ekajana brahmana — there was a brahmana; duyare — at the door

45Then on another day the Lord was dancing,
and at the door stood a brahmana.

হেনই সময়ে আইল আর এক ব্রাহ্মণ ।
গৌরচন্দ্র নৃত্য করে দেখিবারে মন ॥ ৪৬ ॥

henai samaẏe āila āra eka brāhmaṇa |
gauracandra nṛtya kare dekhibāre mana || 46 ||

henai samaye — at that very time; aila ara eka brahmana — another brahmana came; gaurachandra nritya kare — [how] Gaurachandra dances; dekhibare mana — wishing to see

46At that very time another brahmana came:
he wished to see Gaurachandra dance.

দ্বারেতে যে ছিল তারে না দিল যাইতে ।
দুঃখিত হইল বিপ্র না পাঞা দেখিতে ॥ ৪৭ ॥

dbārete ye chila tāre nā dila yāite |
duḥkhita haila bipra nā pāñā dekhite || 47 ||

dvarete ye chhila — the one at the door; tare na dila yaite — did not let him go in; duhkhita haila vipra — the brahmana was grieved; na panna dekhite — not getting to see

47The one who stood at the door did not let him in,
and the brahmana was grieved at not being able to see.1

দুঃখিত হইয়া বিপ্র নিজ ঘরে গেল ।
আনন্দে নাচিল প্রভু কিছু না জানিল ॥ ৪৮ ॥

duḥkhita haiẏā bipra nija ghare gela |
ānande nācila prabhu kichu nā jānila || 48 ||

duhkhita haiya — grieved; vipra nija ghare gela — the brahmana went home; anande nachila prabhu — the Lord danced in joy; kichhu na janila — knew nothing

48Grieved, the brahmana went home;
the Lord danced in joy and knew nothing of it.

তার-পর-দিনে প্রভু-গঙ্গাস্নান-কালে ।
আচম্বিতে সেই দ্বিজ দেখিল প্রভুরে ॥ ৪৯ ॥

tāra-para-dine prabhu-gaṅgāsnāna-kāle |
ācambite sei dbija dekhila prabhure || 49 ||

tara-para-dine — the next day; prabhu-ganga-snana-kale — at the time of the Lord's bath in the Ganga; achambite — suddenly; sei dvija dekhila prabhure — that brahmana saw the Lord

49The next day, as the Lord was bathing in the Ganga,
that brahmana suddenly saw the Lord.

দেখিলেক গঙ্গাস্নানে প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর ।
ক্রোধদৃষ্ট্যে চাহে বিপ্র কাঁপে কলেবর ॥ ৫০ ॥

dekhileka gaṅgāsnāne prabhu biśbambhara |
krodhadṛṣṭye cāhe bipra kāṁpe kalebara || 50 ||

dekhileka — he saw; ganga-snane prabhu vishvambhara — the Lord Vishvambhara bathing in the Ganga; krodha-drishtye chahe vipra — the brahmana glares in anger; kanpe kalebara — his body trembles

50He saw the Lord Vishvambhara bathing in the Ganga —
and the brahmana glares in anger, his whole body trembling.

প্রভুকে দেখিয়া বোলে সক্রোধ বচন ।
তোর ঘরে গেনু তোরে দেখিবারে মন ॥ ৫১ ॥

prabhuke dekhiẏā bole sakrodha bacana |
tora ghare genu tore dekhibāre mana || 51 ||

prabhuke dekhiya — seeing the Lord; bole sakrodha vachana — speaks angry words; tora ghare genu — I went to Your house; tore dekhibare mana — wishing to see You

51Seeing the Lord, he speaks angry words:
"I came to Your house wishing to see You.

তোর নৃত্য দেখিবারে বড় ছিল সাধ ।
পাপিষ্ঠ ব্রাহ্মণ এক তাতে দিল বাধ ॥ ৫২ ॥

tora nṛtya dekhibāre baṛa chila sādha |
pāpiṣṭha brāhmaṇa eka tāte dila bādha || 52 ||

tora nritya dekhibare — to see Your dance; bada chhila sadha — there was great longing; papishtha brahmana eka — a sinful brahmana; tate dila badha — obstructed it

52I greatly longed to see Your dancing,
but a sinful brahmana barred the way.

না দিল যাইতে মোরে বাহির-দুয়ারে ।
তেমনি বাহির তুমি হইবে সংসারে ॥ ৫৩ ॥

nā dila yāite more bāhira-duẏāre |
temani bāhira tumi haibe saṃsāre || 53 ||

na dila yaite more — did not let me go in; bahira-duyare — [leaving me] outside the door; temani bahira tumi — so You outside; haibe samsare — will be of samsara

53He did not let me in, [kept me] outside the door —
so You too shall be outside samsara!"

ইহা বলি' উপবীত ছিণ্ডিলেক ক্রোধে ।
ক্রোধে অচেতন বিপ্র নাহি পরবোধে ॥ ৫৪ ॥

ihā bali' upabīta chiṇḍileka krodhe |
krodhe acetana bipra nāhi parabodhe || 54 ||

iha bali — saying this; upavita chhindileka krodhe — he tore his sacred thread in anger; krodhe achetana vipra — the brahmana, senseless with rage; nahi parabodhe — heeds no persuasion

54Saying this, he tore his sacred thread in anger;
beside himself with rage, the brahmana heeds no persuasion.2

দ্বারের বাহির কৈল আমি নাহি সহি ।
শাপ দিল হউ তুমি সংসারের বহি ॥ ৫৫ ॥

dbārera bāhira kaila āmi nāhi sahi |
śāpa dila hau tumi saṃsārera bahi || 55 ||

dvarera bahira kaila — they put [me] outside the door; ami nahi sahi — I will not bear it; shapa dila — he cursed; hau tumi samsarera bahi — may You be outside samsara

55"I was put outside the door — I will not bear it!" —
and he cursed: "May You be outside samsara!"

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু হরিষ অন্তর ।
ব্রাহ্মণের শাপ মোরে বড় হৈল বর ॥ ৫৬ ॥

e bola śuniñā prabhu hariṣa antara |
brāhmaṇera śāpa more baṛa haila bara || 56 ||

e bola shuninna — hearing this; prabhu harisha antara — the Lord rejoiced at heart; brahmanera shapa — the brahmana's curse; more bada haila bara — has become a great boon for Me

56Hearing this, the Lord rejoiced at heart:
"The brahmana's curse has become a great blessing for Me!"

শাপ স্বীকার যবে কৈল ভগবান্ ।
শুনিঞা ব্রাহ্মণ ভয় পাইল বড় মন ॥ ৫৭ ॥

śāpa sbīkāra yabe kaila bhagabān |
śuniñā brāhmaṇa bhaẏa pāila baṛa mana || 57 ||

shapa svikara — acceptance of the curse; yabe kaila bhagavan — when Bhagavan made; shuninna brahmana — hearing, the brahmana; bhaya paila bada mana — grew greatly afraid at heart

57When Bhagavan accepted the curse,
the brahmana, hearing it, grew greatly afraid at heart:

আমি কি করিব প্রভু যে বোলাইলে তুমি ।
তুমি সর্ব-পরিপূর্ণ সর্ব-অন্তর্যামী ॥ ৫৮ ॥

āmi ki kariba prabhu ye bolāile tumi |
tumi sarba-paripūrṇa sarba-antaryāmī || 58 ||

ami ki kariba prabhu — what could I do, Lord; ye bolaile tumi — You made me say it; tumi sarva-paripurna — You are all-perfect; sarva-antaryami — the Inner Witness of all

58"What could I do, Lord? It is You who made me say it:
You are all-perfect, the Inner Witness of all.

কুতর্কের গণ সব নিস্তার করিবে ।
সন্ন্যাস করিয়া তা-সভারে প্রেম দিবে ॥ ৫৯ ॥

kutarkera gaṇa saba nistāra karibe |
sannyāsa kariẏā tā-sabhāre prema dibe || 59 ||

kutarkera gana saba — all the crowd of disputants; nistara karibe — You will deliver; sannyasa kariya — taking sannyasa; ta-sabhare prema dibe — You will give them prema

59You will deliver all who are given to idle argument:
taking sannyasa, You will give them prema.

সন্ন্যাসী বলিয়া গুরু তোমারে বলিবে ।
সেই নম্রভাবে প্রেম তা-সভারে দিবে ॥ ৬০ ॥

sannyāsī baliẏā guru tomāre balibe |
sei namrabhābe prema tā-sabhāre dibe || 60 ||

sannyasi baliya — as a sannyasi; guru tomare balibe — they will call You guru; sei namra-bhave — through that humility; prema ta-sabhare dibe — You will give them prema

60Seeing You a sannyasi, they will call You 'guru',
and through that humility You will give them prema.

পরম চতুরশিরোমণি গৌরহরি ।
বিলাইবে পূর্ব প্রেম-ভাণ্ডার উঘাড়ি' ॥ ৬১ ॥

parama caturaśiromaṇi gaurahari |
bilāibe pūrba prema-bhāṇḍāra ughāṛi' || 61 ||

parama chatura-shiromani — the supreme crest-jewel of the wise; gaurahari — Gaurahari; vilaibe — will distribute; purva prema-bhandara ughadi — opening the storehouse of former prema

61Gaurahari, the crest-jewel of the wise,
will open the storehouse of the prema of former times and distribute it.

তোমার প্রতিজ্ঞা এই ব্রহ্মাণ্ড ডুবাবে ।
দুর্জন সুজন সভা কারে না রাখিবে ॥ ৬২ ॥

tomāra pratijñā ei brahmāṇḍa ḍubābe |
durjana sujana sabhā kāre nā rākhibe || 62 ||

tomara pratijna ei — this is Your vow; brahmanda dubabe — You will flood the universe; durjana sujana — the wicked and the good; sabha kare na rakhibe — You will leave out none

62You have vowed to flood the universe [with prema] —
You will leave out no one, neither the wicked nor the good.

আমি সে বঞ্চিত হৈলুঁ তোর প্রেম-বানে ।
কি হইবে মোর গতি পতিতপাবনে ॥ ৬৩ ॥

āmi se bañcita hailuṁ tora prema-bāne |
ki haibe mora gati patitapābane || 63 ||

ami se vanchita hailun — I alone was deprived; tora prema-bane — of the flood of Your prema; ki haibe mora gati — what will be my fate; patita-pavane — O Purifier of the fallen

63I alone have been left out of the flood of Your prema:
what will become of me, O Purifier of the fallen?"3

শুনি' প্রভু বোলে শাপ নহে মোর বর ।
মোর বাঞ্ছা পূর্ণ কৈলে নাহি তোর ডর ॥ ৬৪ ॥

śuni' prabhu bole śāpa nahe mora bara |
mora bāñchā pūrṇa kaile nāhi tora ḍara || 64 ||

shuni — hearing; prabhu bole — the Lord says; shapa nahe — it is no curse; mora bara — a boon for Me; mora vanchha purna kaile — you fulfilled My desire; nahi tora dara — have no fear

64Hearing this, the Lord says: "It is not a curse — it is a blessing for Me:
you have fulfilled My desire; do not fear."

শুনিঞা পড়িলা বিপ্র প্রভুর চরণে ।
তুলিয়া ত মহাপ্রভু কৈল আলিঙ্গনে ॥ ৬৫ ॥

śuniñā paṛilā bipra prabhura caraṇe |
tuliẏā ta mahāprabhu kaila āliṅgane || 65 ||

shuninna — hearing; padila vipra — the brahmana fell; prabhura charane — at the Lord's feet; tuliya ta mahaprabhu — raising him, Mahaprabhu; kaila alingane — embraced him

65Hearing this, the brahmana fell at the Lord's feet,
and Mahaprabhu, raising him, embraced him.

প্রভু-আলিঙ্গনে বিপ্র প্রেমায় আকুল ।
গরগর কৃষ্ণপ্রেমে হইল তরল ॥ ৬৬ ॥

prabhu-āliṅgane bipra premāẏa ākula |
garagara kṛṣṇapreme haila tarala || 66 ||

prabhu-alingane — in the Lord's embrace; vipra premaya akula — the brahmana was overwhelmed with prema; garagara krishna-preme — brimming with prema for Krishna; haila tarala — he melted

66In the Lord's embrace the brahmana is beside himself with prema:
overflowing with prema for Krishna, he melted.

বিপ্রের মানস পূর্ণ কৈল ভগবান্ ।
ব্রহ্মার দুর্লভ প্রেম তারে দিলা দান ॥ ৬৭ ॥

biprera mānasa pūrṇa kaila bhagabān |
brahmāra durlabha prema tāre dilā dāna || 67 ||

viprera manasa — the brahmana's desire; purna kaila bhagavan — Bhagavan fulfilled; brahmara durlabha prema — prema rare even for Brahma; tare dila dana — He gave him as a gift

67Bhagavan fulfilled the brahmana's desire —
He gave him prema, hard even for Brahma to obtain.

হেন চিত্র লীলা করে গৌরাঙ্গসুন্দর ।
বুঝিতে না পারে দুষ্ট-অন্তর পামর ॥ ৬৮ ॥

hena citra līlā kare gaurāṅgasundara |
bujhite nā pāre duṣṭa-antara pāmara || 68 ||

hena chitra lila — such wondrous pastimes; kare gaurangasundara — Gaurangasundara performs; bujhite na pare — cannot understand; dushta-antara pamara — wicked-hearted scoundrels

68Such wondrous pastimes Gaurangasundara performs —
scoundrels with wicked hearts cannot understand them.

ইহা বলি' মহাপ্রভু অন্তর উল্লাসে ।
গোরাগুণ গায় সুখে এ লোচনদাসে ॥ ৬৯ ॥

ihā bali' mahāprabhu antara ullāse |
gorāguṇa gāẏa sukhe e locanadāse || 69 ||

iha bali — saying this; mahaprabhu antara ullase — Mahaprabhu rejoices at heart; gora-guna gaya sukhe — happily sings Gora's qualities; e lochana-dase — this Lochana Dasa

69Thus Mahaprabhu rejoiced at heart —
and Lochana Dasa happily sings of Gora's qualities.

Shachi's Grief over the Brahmana's Curse

Raga — any (yatha-raga)

প্রভুকে সে ব্রহ্মশাপ লোকমুখে শুনি' ।
আচম্বিতে কাঁপি' উঠে শচীর পরাণি ॥ ৬৯+১ ॥

prabhuke se brahmaśāpa lokamukhe śuni' |
ācambite kāṁpi' uṭhe śacīra parāṇi || 69+1 ||

prabhuke se brahma-shapa — that brahmana's curse on the Lord; loka-mukhe shuni — hearing from people's lips; achambite — suddenly; kanpi uthe — trembles; shachira parani — Shachi's soul

69+1Hearing from people's lips of the brahmana's curse on the Lord,
Shachi suddenly trembled to the depths of her soul4.

ধকধক প্রাণ পোড়ে বৃত্তান্ত না জানে ।
নিবারিতে নারে অশ্রু ভরে দু-নয়ানে ॥ ৬৯+২ ॥

dhakadhaka prāṇa poṛe bṛttānta nā jāne |
nibārite nāre aśru bhare du-naẏāne || 69+2 ||

dhakadhaka prana pode — her heart pounds and burns; vrittanta na jane — she does not know what happened; nivarite nare — cannot hold back; ashru bhare du-nayane — tears fill both eyes

69+2Her heart pounds and burns — she does not know what has happened;
she cannot hold back her tears — both eyes are full.

ব্যাকুল হৈয়া শচী পুছে সর্বজনে ।
প্রভুরে সে ব্রহ্মশাপ সবার বদনে ॥ ৬৯+৩ ॥

byākula haiẏā śacī puche sarbajane |
prabhure se brahmaśāpa sabāra badane || 69+3 ||

vyakula haiya — in distress; shachi puchhe sarvajane — Shachi asks everyone; prabhure se brahma-shapa — the brahmana's curse on the Lord; sabara vadane — on everyone's lips

69+3In distress Shachi asks everyone —
and on everyone's lips is the brahmana's curse on the Lord.

শুনিয়া মূর্ছিত হৈয়া পড়িলা তথায় ।
চেতন পাইয়া শচী কান্দে উভরায় ॥ ৬৯+৪ ॥

śuniẏā mūrchita haiẏā paṛilā tathāẏa |
cetana pāiẏā śacī kānde ubharāẏa || 69+4 ||

shuniya — hearing; murchhita haiya padila tathaya — fell there senseless; chetana paiya — coming to herself; shachi kande ubharaya — Shachi weeps aloud

69+4Hearing this, she fell there senseless;
coming to herself, Shachi weeps aloud.

কান্দিতে কান্দিতে আইলা আপনার ঘর ।
ক্ষণেক অন্তরে গৃহে আইলা বিশ্বম্ভর ॥ ৬৯+৫ ॥

kāndite kāndite āilā āpanāra ghara |
kṣaṇeka antare gṛhe āilā biśbambhara || 69+5 ||

kandite kandite — weeping; aila apanara ghara — came to her home; kshaneka antare — a little later; grihe aila vishvambhara — Vishvambhara came home

69+5Weeping, she returned home;
a little later Vishvambhara came home too.

গৌর-মুখ দেখি' মায়ের শোক উথলিল ।
কান্দিতে কান্দিতে শচী পুছিতে লাগিল ॥ ৬৯+৬ ॥

gaura-mukha dekhi' māẏera śoka uthalila |
kāndite kāndite śacī puchite lāgila || 69+6 ||

gaura-mukha dekhi — seeing Gaura's face; mayera shoka uthalila — the mother's grief welled up; kandite kandite — weeping; shachi puchhite lagila — Shachi began to ask

69+6Seeing Gaura's face, the mother's grief welled up,
and, weeping, Shachi began to ask:

শুন রে নিমাই বাপ কিবা কথা শুনি ।
তোমারে ব্রাহ্মণ নাকি দিল শাপবাণী ॥ ৬৯+৭ ॥

śuna re nimāi bāpa kibā kathā śuni |
tomāre brāhmaṇa nāki dila śāpabāṇī || 69+7 ||

shuna re nimai bapa — listen, my son Nimai; kiba katha shuni — what do I hear; tomare brahmana naki — is it true that a brahmana to you; dila shapa-vani — pronounced a curse

69+7"Listen, my son Nimai, what is this I hear?
They say a brahmana has pronounced a curse on you?

কোন্ অপরাধ তুমি কৈলে তার স্থান ।
কেমন ব্রাহ্মণ তার কি কঠিন প্রাণ ॥ ৬৯+৮ ॥

kon aparādha tumi kaile tāra sthāna |
kemana brāhmaṇa tāra ki kaṭhina prāṇa || 69+8 ||

kon aparadha — what offence; tumi kaile tara sthana — did you commit against him; kemana brahmana — what sort of brahmana; tara ki kathina prana — how hard his heart

69+8What offence did you commit against him?
What sort of brahmana is he — how hard his heart!

তোর মুখ দেখি' তার দয়া নাহি হৈল ।
আমার বধের ভাগী কোন্ জন হৈল ॥ ৬৯+৯ ॥

tora mukha dekhi' tāra daẏā nāhi haila |
āmāra badhera bhāgī kon jana haila || 69+9 ||

tora mukha dekhi — looking at your face; tara daya nahi haila — he felt no pity; amara vadhera bhagi — guilty of my death; kon jana haila — who has become

69+9Looking at your face, he felt no pity!
Who will be guilty of my death?

এ ঘরকরণ মোর সব তোমা লৈয়া ।
অভাগী শচীর প্রাণ যায় বিদরিয়া ॥ ৬৯+১০ ॥

e gharakaraṇa mora saba tomā laiẏā |
abhāgī śacīra prāṇa yāẏa bidariẏā || 69+10 ||

e gharakarana mora saba — all this house and household of mine; toma laiya — is for you; abhagi shachira prana — unfortunate Shachi's heart; yaya vidariya — is breaking

69+10All this house and household of mine is only for you;
the heart of unfortunate Shachi is breaking.

সবার দুলাল তুমি মোর আঁখি-তারা ।
বিধির বিপাকে পাছে তোমা হই হারা ॥ ৬৯+১১ ॥

sabāra dulāla tumi mora āṁkhi-tārā |
bidhira bipāke pāche tomā hai hārā || 69+11 ||

sabara dulala tumi — you are everyone's darling; mora ankhi-tara — the apple of my eye; vidhira vipake — by an evil turn of fate; pachhe toma hai hara — lest I lose you

69+11You are everyone's darling, the apple of my eye:
may I not lose you by some evil turn of fate!

অমিয়া-সিনান করি' দেখি তোর মুখ ।
দারুণ বচন শুনি' ফাটে মোর বুক ॥ ৬৯+১২ ॥

amiẏā-sināna kari' dekhi tora mukha |
dāruṇa bacana śuni' phāṭe mora buka || 69+12 ||

amiya-sinana kari — as if bathing in nectar; dekhi tora mukha — I look at your face; daruna vachana shuni — hearing cruel words; phate mora buka — my breast bursts

69+12Looking at your face, I bathe as if in nectar —
and hearing cruel words, my breast is bursting.

অভাগী শচীর ভাগ্যে না জানি কি হব ।
তোর অমঙ্গল হৈলে পরাণে মরিব ॥ ৬৯+১৩ ॥

abhāgī śacīra bhāgye nā jāni ki haba |
tora amaṅgala haile parāṇe mariba || 69+13 ||

abhagi shachira bhagye — in unfortunate Shachi's lot; na jani ki haba — I know not what will be; tora amangala haile — if harm comes to you; parane mariba — I shall die

69+13I know not what fate awaits unfortunate Shachi:
if harm comes to you, I shall die."

এ বোল শুনিয়া তবে গৌরাঙ্গ সুন্দর ।
মায়েরে কহয়ে কিছু প্রবোধ-উত্তর ॥ ৬৯+১৪ ॥

e bola śuniẏā tabe gaurāṅga sundara |
māẏere kahaẏe kichu prabodha-uttara || 69+14 ||

e bola shuniya — hearing these words; tabe gauranga sundara — then beautiful Gauranga; mayere kahaye — says to His mother; kichhu prabodha-uttara — an answer in consolation

69+14Hearing these words, beautiful Gauranga
gives His mother this answer in consolation:

শুন গো জননী তুমি আমার বচন ।
কি লাগিয়া রোদন করহ অকারণ ॥ ৬৯+১৫ ॥

śuna go jananī tumi āmāra bacana |
ki lāgiẏā rodana karaha akāraṇa || 69+15 ||

shuna go janani — listen, mother; tumi amara vachana — you, My word; ki lagiya — why; rodana karaha akarana — do you weep for nothing

69+15"Listen, mother, to My word:
why do you weep for nothing?

মোর অপরাধ নাহি ব্রাহ্মণের স্থানে ।
মোরে যে শাপিল বিপ্র সেহ অকারণে ॥ ৬৯+১৬ ॥

mora aparādha nāhi brāhmaṇera sthāne |
more ye śāpila bipra seha akāraṇe || 69+16 ||

mora aparadha nahi — I have no offence; brahmanera sthane — against the brahmana; more ye shapila vipra — that the brahmana cursed Me; seha akarane — that too was without cause

69+16I have committed no offence against the brahmana:
the brahmana cursed Me without cause.

বিনি অপরাধে শাপ লাগিবে বা কেনে ।
নিশ্চয় জানিহ মাতা এ সত্য বচনে ॥ ৬৯+১৭ ॥

bini aparādhe śāpa lāgibe bā kene |
niścaẏa jāniha mātā e satya bacane || 69+17 ||

vini aparadhe — without an offence; shapa lagibe ba kene — how can a curse take effect; nishchaya janiha mata — know for certain, mother; e satya vachane — this is a true word

69+17And how can a curse take effect without an offence?
Know for certain, mother: this is a true word"5.

ইহা বলি' গেলা প্রভু জাহ্নবীর তীর ।
সুরনদী স্নান করি' আইলা নিজ ঘর ॥ ৬৯+১৮ ॥

ihā bali' gelā prabhu jāhnabīra tīra |
suranadī snāna kari' āilā nija ghara || 69+18 ||

iha bali — saying this; gela prabhu jahnavira tira — the Lord went to the bank of the Jahnavi; suranadi snana kari — bathing in the heavenly river; aila nija ghara — came home

69+18Saying this, the Lord went to the bank of the Jahnavi
and, bathing in the heavenly river, came back home.

ঘরে আসি' মহাপ্রভু পরম সাদরে ।
কৃষ্ণ-পূজার্চনা করে হরিষ-অন্তরে ॥ ৬৯+১৯ ॥

ghare āsi' mahāprabhu parama sādare |
kṛṣṇa-pūjārcanā kare hariṣa-antare || 69+19 ||

ghare asi — returning home; mahaprabhu parama sadare — Mahaprabhu with great reverence; krishna-pujarchana kare — performs the worship of Krishna; harisha-antare — with joy in His heart

69+19Returning home, Mahaprabhu with great reverence
and joy in His heart performs the worship of Krishna.

পূজা করি' স্তব পাঠ পড়ি' কতক্ষণ ।
তুলসীরে জল দিলা প্রেমাবিষ্ট মন ॥ ৬৯+২০ ॥

pūjā kari' staba pāṭha paṛi' katakṣaṇa |
tulasīre jala dilā premābiṣṭa mana || 69+20 ||

puja kari — having worshipped; stava patha padi katakshana — recited hymns for a while; tulasire jala dila — watered the tulasi; premavishta mana — absorbed in prema

69+20Having worshipped, He recited hymns for a while
and, absorbed in prema, watered the tulasi.

প্রণাম করিয়া প্রভু কৈলা জলপান ।
সাদরে নিরীখে শচী পুত্রের বয়ান ॥ ৬৯+২১ ॥

praṇāma kariẏā prabhu kailā jalapāna |
sādare nirīkhe śacī putrera baẏāna || 69+21 ||

pranama kariya — having bowed down; prabhu kaila jalapana — the Lord took refreshment; sadare nirikhe shachi — Shachi gazes tenderly; putrera bayana — at her son's face

69+21Having bowed down, the Lord took refreshment,
and Shachi gazes tenderly at her son's face.

কোটি চান্দ জিনি' গোরার বদন-প্রকাশ ।
গৌরাঙ্গ-চরিত্র কহে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৬৯+২২ ॥

koṭi cānda jini' gorāra badana-prakāśa |
gaurāṅga-caritra kahe e locanadāsa || 69+22 ||

koti chanda jini — outshining millions of moons; gorara vadana-prakasha — the radiance of Gora's face; gauranga-charitra kahe — tells of Gauranga's deeds; e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa

69+22The radiance of Gora's face outshines millions of moons;
of Gauranga's deeds this Lochana Dasa tells.

Mahaprabhu Distributes Prema in His Bhavas

Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati. Sriman Mahaprabhu [one day] danced together [with the devotees] in the bhava of Varaha. Then, [saying] that Shiva, Shuka, Narada, Brahma and other sages worship God by song, that the best [dharma] of the Kali age is the sankirtana of the name, and that [Gaurahari] has descended to distribute this dharma at the door of every living being, Sriman Mahaprabhu ordered the devotees headed by Advaita Acharya [to preach it] and, singing with His own the stories of the gopis, in the bhava of a gopi He went with sankirtana to the house of Chandrashekhara Acharya; [Srivasa] Pandita was filled with the bhava of Narada. In His bhava Sriman Mahaprabhu glorified before all the greatness of Gadadhara Pandita and revealed that he is Radhika, [worshipped by] Brahma, Shiva, Narada and others. Then Thakura Haridasa [came], and all the Vaishnavas joined them in the sankirtana of the name and prema. [Dancing] in the bhava of a gopi, [the Lord] suddenly became filled with the bhava of His majesty; then the devotees saw Him in the form of Lakshmi and offered praise to Lakshmi. [In the bhava of Lakshmi the Lord] distributed the prema of service; at that time someone came and loudly called Sriman Mahaprabhu "Prabhu!" — and [the Lord, giving up] that bhava, in the bhava of Ishvara distributed prema to all.6

Raga vibhasa; disha: "Glory, glory to Gaurachand, risen in Nadia in the Kali age!" (murchha); refrain: "Hear the story of my Lord, whose qualities have lit up the three worlds! Hear the story of Gaurangachand!"

আর কথা কহি শুন বড় অপরূপ ।
নদিয়া-নগরে নিত নূতন কৌতুক ॥ ১ ॥

āra kathā kahi śuna baṛa aparūpa |
nadiẏā-nagare nita nūtana kautuka || 1 ||

ara katha kahi — I tell another story; shuna bada aparupa — listen, most wondrous; nadiya-nagare — in the town of Nadia; nita nutana kautuka — daily a new marvel

1I shall tell another story — listen, it is most wondrous:
in the town of Nadia every day there is a new marvel.

নিজঘরে বৈসে প্রভু আনন্দিত মন ।
চৌদিগে বেড়িয়া বৈসে সব নিজজন ॥ ২ ॥

nijaghare baise prabhu ānandita mana |
caudige beṛiẏā baise saba nijajana || 2 ||

nijaghare baise prabhu — the Lord sits in His house; anandita mana — joyful at heart; chaudige bediya baise — sit around Him; saba nijajana — all His own

2The Lord sits in His house, joyful at heart,
and all His own sit around Him.

আচম্বিতে এক ধ্বনি উঠিল গগনে ।
মধু দেহ বলি' ডাকে এ মেঘ-নিঃস্বনে ॥ ৩ ॥

ācambite eka dhbani uṭhila gagane |
madhu deha bali' ḍāke e megha-niḥsbane || 3 ||

achambite — suddenly; eka dhvani uthila gagane — a cry rose to the sky; madhu deha bali — saying "give honey"; dake e megha-nihsvane — He calls in a voice like a thundercloud

3Suddenly a cry rose to the sky:
in a voice like a thundercloud He calls: "Give Me honey!"

সেইক্ষণে ধরে প্রভু হলায়ুধ-রূপ ।
নীলবসন শ্বেতপর্বত-স্বরূপ ॥ ৪ ॥

seikṣaṇe dhare prabhu halāẏudha-rūpa |
nīlabasana śbetaparbata-sbarūpa || 4 ||

sei-kshane — at that moment; dhare prabhu halayudha-rupa — the Lord assumes the form of Halayudha; nila-vasana — clad in blue; shveta-parvata-svarupa — like a white mountain

4At that very moment the Lord assumes the form of Halayudha —
clad in blue, like a white mountain,7

সুন্দর চরণ আর পদ্মলোচনে ।
আশ্চর্য দেখিয়া সবে হৃষ্ট হৈলা মনে ॥ ৫ ॥

sundara caraṇa āra padmalocane |
āścarya dekhiẏā sabe hṛṣṭa hailā mane || 5 ||

sundara charana — beautiful feet; ara padma-lochane — and lotus eyes; ashcharya dekhiya — seeing the marvel; sabe hrishta haila mane — all rejoiced at heart

5with beautiful feet and lotus eyes;
seeing this marvel, all rejoiced at heart.

সর্বজন-প্রেমদাতা প্রেম বিলসয় ।
আপন আবেশ ধরি' নাচে মহাশয় ॥ ৬ ॥

sarbajana-premadātā prema bilasaẏa |
āpana ābeśa dhari' nāce mahāśaẏa || 6 ||

sarvajana-prema-data — the Giver of prema to all; prema vilasaya — enjoys prema; apana avesha dhari — holding to His own bhava; nache mahashaya — the Great Soul dances

6The Giver of prema to all enjoys prema:
in His bhava the Great Soul dances.

হরিনাম গায় সব-নিজ-জন-সনে ।
সেইমনে গেলা অদ্বৈত-মুরারির স্থানে ॥ ৭ ॥

harināma gāẏa saba-nija-jana-sane |
seimane gelā adbaita-murārira sthāne || 7 ||

hari-nama gaya — singing the name of Hari; saba-nija-jana-sane — with all His own; sei-mane — thus; gela advaita-murarira sthane — went to Advaita and Murari

7Singing the name of Hari with all His own,
thus He went to Advaita and Murari.8

তথা গিয়া কহে প্রভু গদগদ ভাষ ।
মধু দেহ দেহ বলি' অট্ট-অট্ট হাস ॥ ৮ ॥

tathā giẏā kahe prabhu gadagada bhāṣa |
madhu deha deha bali' aṭṭa-aṭṭa hāsa || 8 ||

tatha giya — going there; kahe prabhu gadgada bhasha — the Lord speaks in a faltering voice; madhu deha deha bali — saying "give, give honey"; atta-atta hasa — laughs aloud

8Going there, the Lord speaks in a faltering voice,
crying "Give, give Me honey!" — and laughs aloud.

দেহের বরণ যেন বাল-দিননাথ ।
মধু দেহ দেহ বলি' ঘন পাতে হাথ ॥ ৯ ॥

dehera baraṇa yena bāla-dinanātha |
madhu deha deha bali' ghana pāte hātha || 9 ||

dehera barana — the colour of the body; yena bala-dinanatha — like the rising sun; madhu deha deha bali — saying "give, give honey"; ghana pate hatha — again and again holds out His hand

9The colour of His body is like the rising sun;
"Give, give Me honey!" He says, holding out His hand.

তোয়পূর্ণ ভাজন ধরিয়া নিজকরে ।
মধুপান করি' তোলে রসের উদ্গারে ॥ ১০ ॥

toẏapūrṇa bhājana dhariẏā nijakare |
madhupāna kari' tole rasera udgāre || 10 ||

toya-purna bhajana — a vessel full of water; dhariya nija-kare — taking in His hand; madhu-pana kari — drinking [it as] honey; tole rasera udgare — belches with relish

10Taking in His hand a vessel full of water,
He drinks [it as] honey and belches with relish.9

টলমল করি' নাচে প্রেমে মাতোয়াল ।
হেউ-হেউ করি' তোলে রসের উদ্গার ॥ ১১ ॥

ṭalamala kari' nāce preme mātoẏāla |
heu-heu kari' tole rasera udgāra || 11 ||

talamala kari — reeling; nache preme matoyala — dances intoxicated with prema; heu-heu kari — going "heu-heu"; tole rasera udgara — belches with relish

11Reeling, He dances, intoxicated with prema,
and belches with relish: "heu, heu!"

ক্ষণে পড়ে ক্ষণে উঠে ক্ষণে কান্দে হাসে ।
অধর মিটাই' ক্ষণে অট্ট-অট্ট হাসে ॥ ১২ ॥

kṣaṇe paṛe kṣaṇe uṭhe kṣaṇe kānde hāse |
adhara miṭāi' kṣaṇe aṭṭa-aṭṭa hāse || 12 ||

kshane pade — now falls; kshane uthe — now rises; kshane kande hase — now weeps, now laughs; adhara mitai — smacking His lips; kshane atta-atta hase — now laughs aloud

12Now He falls, now rises, now weeps, now laughs,
now, smacking His lips, laughs aloud.

দেখিয়া সকল লোক করয়ে স্তবন ।
হলধর বলি' কেহ ধরয়ে চরণ ॥ ১৩ ॥

dekhiẏā sakala loka karaẏe stabana |
haladhara bali' keha dharaẏe caraṇa || 13 ||

dekhiya sakala loka — seeing this, all the people; karaye stavana — offer praise; haladhara bali — crying "Haladhara"; keha dharaye charana — some clasp His feet

13Seeing this, all the people offer praise,
and some, crying "Haladhara!", clasp His feet.

তবে সেই মহাপ্রভু লীলা-বলরাম ।
কহয়ে অমৃত-কথা অতি অনুপাম ॥ ১৪ ॥

tabe sei mahāprabhu līlā-balarāma |
kahaẏe amṛta-kathā ati anupāma || 14 ||

tabe sei mahaprabhu — then Mahaprabhu; lila-balarama — playing Balarama; kahaye amrita-katha — speaks nectarean words; ati anupama — incomparable

14Then Mahaprabhu, playing Balarama,
speaks incomparable, nectarean words:

শ্রীকৃষ্ণ নহিয়ে আমি বোলে হব সুখী ।
অদ্ভুত সুপেয় মধু আনি' দেহ দেখি ॥ ১৫ ॥

śrīkṛṣṇa nahiẏe āmi bole haba sukhī |
adbhuta supeẏa madhu āni' deha dekhi || 15 ||

shri-krishna nahiye ami — I am not Sri Krishna; bole haba sukhi — to be pleased by words; adbhuta supeya madhu — wonderful, sweet honey; ani deha dekhi — bring Me, come

15"I am not Sri Krishna, to be pleased with words —
bring Me wonderful, sweet honey!"10

সেইখানে এক দ্বিজ ছিল দাঁড়াইয়া ।
এই মল্ল বলি' ফেলে অঙ্গুলে ঠেলিয়া ॥ ১৬ ॥

seikhāne eka dbija chila dāṁṛāiẏā |
ei malla bali' phele aṅgule ṭheliẏā || 16 ||

seikhane — there; eka dvija chhila dandaiya — a brahmana stood; ei malla bali — saying "here is a wrestler"; phele angule theliya — throws him down with a push of the finger

16A brahmana was standing there;
"Here is a wrestler!" [the Lord] said, and pushed him with a finger.

অঙ্গুলি-ঠেলায় বিপ্র পড়ে বহুদূর ।
লজ্জা সে পাইল বিপ্র ফেলিল ঠাকুর ॥ ১৭ ॥

aṅguli-ṭhelāẏa bipra paṛe bahudūra |
lajjā se pāila bipra phelila ṭhākura || 17 ||

anguli-thelaya — by the push of a finger; vipra pade bahudura — the brahmana falls far off; lajja se paila vipra — the brahmana felt ashamed; phelila thakura — the Thakura threw him

17At the push of a finger the brahmana flew far off;
the brahmana was ashamed: the Thakura had thrown him down.

প্রভাতে আবেশ ভেল সায়াহ্ন সময় ।
লীলা-বলরাম ক্রীড়া করে মহাশয় ॥ ১৮ ॥

prabhāte ābeśa bhela sāẏāhna samaẏa |
līlā-balarāma krīṛā kare mahāśaẏa || 18 ||

prabhate avesha bhela — the bhava began in the morning; sayahna samaya — [until] evening; lila-balarama — playing Balarama; krida kare mahashaya — the Great Soul sports

18This bhava began in the morning [and lasted] until evening:
the Great Soul sports, playing Balarama.

নরহরি-পাদপদ্ম শিরের ভূষণ ।
ধন্য গোরাগুণ কহে এ দাস লোচন ॥ ১৯ ॥

narahari-pādapadma śirera bhūṣaṇa |
dhanya gorāguṇa kahe e dāsa locana || 19 ||

narahari-pada-padma — the lotus feet of Narahari; shirera bhushana — the ornament of the head; dhanya gora-guna — Gora's blessed qualities; kahe e dasa lochana — this Lochana Dasa tells

19The lotus feet of Narahari are the ornament of my head;
this Lochana Dasa sings of Gora's blessed qualities.

তার পরদিনে শুন অপরূপ আর ।
নাচয়ে ঠাকুর বলদেব-অনুকার ॥ ২০ ॥

tāra paradine śuna aparūpa āra |
nācaẏe ṭhākura baladeba-anukāra || 20 ||

tara paradine — on the following day; shuna aparupa ara — hear another wonder; nachaye thakura — the Thakura dances; baladeva-anukara — imitating Baladeva

20Hear one more wonder — on the following day
the Thakura dances, imitating Baladeva.

আচম্বিতে পরিতাপ করি' পাইল মোহ ।
বলরাম-স্মরণে নয়নে বহে লোহ ॥ ২১ ॥

ācambite paritāpa kari' pāila moha |
balarāma-smaraṇe naẏane bahe loha || 21 ||

achambite — suddenly; paritapa kari — in grief; paila moha — He fainted; balarama-smarane — remembering Balarama; nayane bahe loha — tears flow from His eyes

21Suddenly, in grief, He fainted;
remembering Balarama, He sheds tears.

ভূমিতে লোটায় মহাপ্রভু মুক্তকেশ ।
মুখে জল দেয় সব-জন পায় ক্লেশ ॥ ২২ ॥

bhūmite loṭāẏa mahāprabhu muktakeśa |
mukhe jala deẏa saba-jana pāẏa kleśa || 22 ||

bhumite lotaya — rolls on the ground; mahaprabhu mukta-kesha — Mahaprabhu with loosened hair; mukhe jala deya — they put water on His face; saba-jana paya klesha — all are in distress

22Mahaprabhu rolls on the ground with His hair loose;
they sprinkle water on His face — all are in distress.

ক্ষণেকে হইল সংজ্ঞা গদাধর দেখি' ।
কহিল কাতর-বাণী ইঙ্গিতে সে লখি' ॥ ২৩ ॥

kṣaṇeke haila saṃjñā gadādhara dekhi' |
kahila kātara-bāṇī iṅgite se lakhi' || 23 ||

kshaneke haila samjna — in a moment He regained consciousness; gadadhara dekhi — seeing Gadadhara; kahila katara-vani — spoke anguished words; ingite se lakhi — perceiving the sign

23In a moment, seeing Gadadhara, He came to Himself
and, understanding [his] silent sign, spoke anguished words:

তুমি সে আমার বন্ধু প্রাণসম জানি ।
তোর প্রেমে বশ আমি শুন দ্বিজমণি ॥ ২৪ ॥

tumi se āmāra bandhu prāṇasama jāni |
tora preme baśa āmi śuna dbijamaṇi || 24 ||

tumi se amara bandhu — you are My friend; prana-sama jani — I know you are as dear as life; tora preme basha ami — I am subject to your love; shuna dvija-mani — listen, jewel of brahmanas

24"You are My friend — I know you are as dear to Me as life;
I am conquered by your love, listen, jewel of brahmanas.

তোর নাথ মুঞি হঙ তুমি মোর প্রাণ ।
গদাইর গৌরাঙ্গ বোলে কর অবধান ॥ ২৫ ॥

tora nātha muñi haṅa tumi mora prāṇa |
gadāira gaurāṅga bole kara abadhāna || 25 ||

tora natha munni hanga — I am your Lord; tumi mora prana — you are My life; gadaira gauranga bole — they say "Gadai's Gauranga"; kara avadhana — take heed

25I am your Lord, you are My life;
[people] call Me 'Gadai's Gauranga' — mark this.

মোর যত ভাব তোতে নহে অগোচর ।
আমার অন্তরশক্তি তোর কলেবর ॥ ২৬ ॥

mora yata bhāba tote nahe agocara |
āmāra antaraśakti tora kalebara || 26 ||

mora yata bhava — all My bhavas; tote nahe agochara — are not hidden from you; amara antara-shakti — My inner shakti; tora kalebara — is your body

26None of My bhavas is hidden from you:
your body is My inner shakti.11

রাত্রিদিন মোর সঙ্গ তিলেক না ছাড় ।
তোমা বিনে মোর কথা জানে কে বা দঢ় ॥ ২৭ ॥

rātridina mora saṅga tileka nā chāṛa |
tomā bine mora kathā jāne ke bā daṛha || 27 ||

ratri-dina — night and day; mora sanga tileka na chhada — you do not leave My company for a moment; toma vine — apart from you; mora katha jane ke ba dadha — who firmly knows My affairs

27Day and night you do not leave Me for a moment:
who but you truly knows My ways?

মোর প্রিয় বন্ধু যত বৈষ্ণব যে জন ।
আনহ সভারে আমি দেখিব এখন ॥ ২৮ ॥

mora priẏa bandhu yata baiṣṇaba ye jana |
ānaha sabhāre āmi dekhiba ekhana || 28 ||

mora priya bandhu — My dear friends; yata vaishnava ye jana — all who are Vaishnavas; anaha sabhare — bring them all; ami dekhiba ekhana — I shall see them now

28All My dear friends, the Vaishnavas —
bring them; I wish to see them now."

আজ্ঞা পাইয়া গদাধর-পণ্ডিত সভারে ।
আনিল আচার্যরত্ন-আদি যত আরে ॥ ২৯ ॥

ājñā pāiẏā gadādhara-paṇḍita sabhāre |
ānila ācāryaratna-ādi yata āre || 29 ||

ajna paiya — receiving the command; gadadhara-pandita sabhare — Gadadhara Pandita, all; anila — brought; acharyaratna-adi yata are — Acharyaratna and all the others

29Receiving the command, Gadadhara Pandita
brought them all — Acharyaratna and the others.12

আসিয়া দেখিল যত মহোত্তম জন ।
বিভোর হইল সভে সজল-লোচন ॥ ৩০ ॥

āsiẏā dekhila yata mahottama jana |
bibhora haila sabhe sajala-locana || 30 ||

asiya dekhila — coming, they saw; yata mahottama jana — all the great souls; vibhora haila sabhe — all were overwhelmed; sajala-lochana — with tearful eyes

30Coming, all those great souls saw [Him] —
and all were overwhelmed, their eyes filled with tears.

কহিল আচার্যরত্ন মধুর বচন ।
কহ না আপনে বাপ ইহার কারণ ॥ ৩১ ॥

kahila ācāryaratna madhura bacana |
kaha nā āpane bāpa ihāra kāraṇa || 31 ||

kahila acharyaratna — Acharyaratna said; madhura vachana — gentle words; kaha na apane bapa — tell us Yourself, dear child; ihara karana — the cause of this

31Acharyaratna spoke gentle words:
"Tell us Yourself, dear child, what is the cause?"

শুনিঞা তাহার বাণী কহে বিশ্বম্ভর ।
কহিতে না পারে কণ্ঠ গদগদ স্বর ॥ ৩২ ॥

śuniñā tāhāra bāṇī kahe biśbambhara |
kahite nā pāre kaṇṭha gadagada sbara || 32 ||

shuninna tahara vani — hearing his words; kahe vishvambhara — Vishvambhara speaks; kahite na pare — cannot speak; kantha gadgada svara — His throat choked in voice

32Hearing his words, Vishvambhara speaks,
but cannot speak — His voice chokes in His throat.

অতি সুবিহ্বল কহে আধ-আধ বোলে ।
শ্বেতগিরি হলায়ুধ দেখিলুঁ মো কোলে ॥ ৩৩ ॥

ati subihbala kahe ādha-ādha bole |
śbetagiri halāẏudha dekhiluṁ mo kole || 33 ||

ati suvihvala — greatly agitated; kahe adha-adha bole — He speaks in broken words; shveta-giri halayudha — Halayudha, a white mountain; dekhilun mo kole — I saw beside Me

33In great agitation He speaks in broken words:
"I saw Halayudha, like a white mountain — beside Me.

সুবর্ণ-শোভিত সূর্যসম অঙ্গ-প্রভা ।
ঝলমল করে অতি অলঙ্কার-আভা ॥ ৩৪ ॥

subarṇa-śobhita sūryasama aṅga-prabhā |
jhalamala kare ati alaṅkāra-ābhā || 34 ||

suvarna-shobhita — golden-bright; surya-sama anga-prabha — the radiance of His body like the sun; jhalamala kare — flashes brightly; ati alankara-abha — the brilliance of His ornaments

34The radiance of His body, golden, is like the sun,
His ornaments flash brilliantly."

কহিতে কহিতে প্রভু সেই পুনর্বার ।
বলদেব দেখি' শ্বেতপর্বত-আকার ॥ ৩৫ ॥

kahite kahite prabhu sei punarbāra |
baladeba dekhi' śbetaparbata-ākāra || 35 ||

kahite kahite — as He was speaking; prabhu sei punarbara — the Lord again; baladeva dekhi — saw Baladeva; shveta-parvata-akara — in the form of a white mountain

35As He spoke, the Lord again
saw Baladeva, like a white mountain.

তবে সেই মহাপ্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর-রায় ।
সেইমতে তদাবেশে পুনঃ নাচে গায় ॥ ৩৬ ॥

tabe sei mahāprabhu biśbambhara-rāẏa |
seimate tadābeśe punaḥ nāce gāẏa || 36 ||

tabe sei mahaprabhu — then Mahaprabhu; vishvambhara-raya — Vishvambhara-raya; sei-mate tad-aveshe — thus in that bhava; punah nache gaya — again dances and sings

36Then Mahaprabhu Vishvambhara-raya
again, in that bhava, dances and sings.

সকল বৈষ্ণবজন আনন্দে বিহ্বল ।
বলরাম-প্রেমে সভে করে টলমল ॥ ৩৭ ॥

sakala baiṣṇabajana ānande bihbala |
balarāma-preme sabhe kare ṭalamala || 37 ||

sakala vaishnava-jana — all the Vaishnavas; anande vihvala — overwhelmed with bliss; balarama-preme — in prema for Balarama; sabhe kare talamala — all reel

37All the Vaishnavas are overwhelmed with bliss:
in prema for Balarama all of them reel.

আনন্দে ভরল সভার দিগ্-বিদিগে ।
দুইদিন ভেল প্রভুর আবেশ না ভাঙ্গে ॥ ৩৮ ॥

ānande bharala sabhāra dig-bidige |
duidina bhela prabhura ābeśa nā bhāṅge || 38 ||

anande bharala — were filled with bliss; sabhara dig-vidige — all the quarters; dui-dina bhela — two days passed; prabhura avesha na bhange — the Lord's bhava did not break

38Bliss filled all the quarters;
for two days the Lord's bhava did not break.

তবে তার-পর-দিনে নৃত্যের সময় ।
চৌদিগে বেড়িল সব ভক্ত মহাশয় ॥ ৩৯ ॥

tabe tāra-para-dine nṛtyera samaẏa |
caudige beṛila saba bhakta mahāśaẏa || 39 ||

tabe tara-para-dine — then on the following day; nrityera samaya — at the time of dancing; chaudige bedila — surrounded on all sides; saba bhakta mahashaya — all the great devotees

39Then on the following day, at the time of dancing,
all the great devotees surrounded Him on every side.

পদতল-ভারে মহী টলমল করে ।
ঢুলায় অরুণ আঁখি আধ-আধ বোলে ॥ ৪০ ॥

padatala-bhāre mahī ṭalamala kare |
ḍhulāẏa aruṇa āṁkhi ādha-ādha bole || 40 ||

padatala-bhare — under the weight of His feet; mahi talamala kare — the earth shakes; dhulaya aruna ankhi — He rolls His red eyes; adha-adha bole — speaks brokenly

40Under the weight of His feet the earth shakes;
He rolls His reddened eyes and speaks in broken words.

মত্ত করিবর যেন গমন মন্থর ।
চলিতে না পারে প্রেমে ভৈগেল নির্ভর ॥ ৪১ ॥

matta karibara yena gamana manthara |
calite nā pāre preme bhaigela nirbhara || 41 ||

matta karivara yena — like an intoxicated elephant; gamana manthara — His gait is slow; chalite na pare — He cannot walk; preme bhaigela nirbhara — absorbed in prema

41His gait is slow like that of an intoxicated elephant:
He cannot walk, absorbed in prema.

যেন পহুঁ আবেশ-অবশ তেন সঙ্গী ।
নাচয়ে বিহ্বল বলরাম-রঙ্গে রঙ্গী ॥ ৪২ ॥

yena pahuṁ ābeśa-abaśa tena saṅgī |
nācaẏe bihbala balarāma-raṅge raṅgī || 42 ||

yena pahu avesha-avasha — as the Lord is overcome by His bhava; tena sangi — so are His companions; nachaye vihvala — He dances, beside Himself; balarama-range rangi — delighting in Balarama's play

42As the Lord is given over to His bhava, so are His companions:
beside Himself, He dances, delighting in the play of Balarama.

নাচিতে গাইতে ভেল সায়াহ্ন-সময় ।
আচম্বিতে বয়ানে বারুণী-গন্ধ কয় ॥ ৪৩ ॥

nācite gāite bhela sāẏāhna-samaẏa |
ācambite baẏāne bāruṇī-gandha kaẏa || 43 ||

nachite gaite — while dancing and singing; bhela sayahna-samaya — evening came; achambite bayane — suddenly from His mouth; baruni-gandha kaya — the fragrance of varuni spread

43With dancing and singing evening came,
and suddenly from His mouth there wafted the fragrance of varuni.

বারুণীর দিব্যগন্ধে ভেল আমোদিত ।
চৌদিগে নেহারে লোক হৈয়া চমকিত ॥ ৪৪ ॥

bāruṇīra dibyagandhe bhela āmodita |
caudige nehāre loka haiẏā camakita || 44 ||

barunira divya-gandhe — with the divine fragrance of varuni; bhela amodita — [all] became fragrant; chaudige nehare loka — people look all around; haiya chamakita — amazed

44Everything was filled with the divine fragrance of varuni;
the people look about in amazement.

দশদিগ্ আমোদিত বারুণীর গন্ধে ।
মাতল ভকত অতি প্রেম-উন্মাদে ॥ ৪৫ ॥

daśadig āmodita bāruṇīra gandhe |
mātala bhakata ati prema-unmāde || 45 ||

dasha-dig amodita — the ten directions are fragrant; barunira gandhe — with the scent of varuni; matala bhakata — the devotees became intoxicated; ati prema-unmade — in the great madness of prema

45All ten directions are fragrant with the scent of varuni;
the devotees grew intoxicated in the madness of prema.13

হেনকালে শ্রীরামপণ্ডিত দ্বিজবর্য ।
দেখিলেন শুন তার অনুভব-কার্য ॥ ৪৬ ॥

henakāle śrīrāmapaṇḍita dbijabarya |
dekhilena śuna tāra anubhaba-kārya || 46 ||

henakale — at that time; shri-rama-pandita dvijavarya — Sri Rama Pandita, best of brahmanas; dekhilena — saw; shuna tara anubhava-karya — hear what he perceived

46At that time Sri Rama Pandita, the best of brahmanas,
saw — hear what was revealed to him:

আচম্বিতে দিব্য দিব্য পুরুষ-রতন ।
সেইখানে দিব্য-বেশে হৈল উপসন্ন ॥ ৪৭ ॥

ācambite dibya dibya puruṣa-ratana |
seikhāne dibya-beśe haila upasanna || 47 ||

achambite — suddenly; divya divya purusha-ratana — divine, divine jewels among men; seikhane — there; divya-beshe haila upasanna — appeared in divine dress

47suddenly there appeared there
divine, divine jewels among men in divine dress:

কারো এক কর্ণে পদ্ম কমল-লোচন ।
এক কর্ণে কুণ্ডল নীলিম বসন ॥ ৪৮ ॥

kāro eka karṇe padma kamala-locana |
eka karṇe kuṇḍala nīlima basana || 48 ||

karo eka karne padma — each with a lotus in one ear; kamala-lochana — lotus eyes; eka karne kundala — an earring in one ear; nilima vasana — blue garments

48each had a lotus in one ear, lotus eyes,
an earring in the other ear, blue garments;

পীতবস্ত্র পাগড়ি বান্ধিয়া লটপটি ।
কহিতে না পারি রূপ-বেশ-পরিপাটি ॥ ৪৯ ॥

pītabastra pāgaṛi bāndhiẏā laṭapaṭi |
kahite nā pāri rūpa-beśa-paripāṭi || 49 ||

pita-vastra pagadi — yellow cloth turbans; bandhiya latapati — tied loosely; kahite na pari — I cannot describe; rupa-besha-paripati — the elegance of form and dress

49on their heads yellow turbans, loosely tied —
I cannot describe the beauty and elegance of their forms and dress.

বনমালী নাম এক ব্রাহ্মণ তথাই ।
কহিব তাহার কথা শুন সব ভাই ॥ ৫০ ॥

banamālī nāma eka brāhmaṇa tathāi |
kahiba tāhāra kathā śuna saba bhāi || 50 ||

vanamali nama — named Vanamali; eka brahmana tathai — a brahmana was there; kahiba tahara katha — I shall tell of him; shuna saba bhai — listen, all brothers

50There was a brahmana there named Vanamali —
I shall tell of him; listen, all brothers:

দেখিলেক কাঞ্চন-নির্মিত কলেবর ।
রত্ন-বিভূষিত যেন সুমেরু-শিখর ॥ ৫১ ॥

dekhileka kāñcana-nirmita kalebara |
ratna-bibhūṣita yena sumeru-śikhara || 51 ||

dekhileka — he saw; kanchana-nirmita kalebara — a body made of gold; ratna-vibhushita — adorned with gems; yena sumeru-shikhara — like the peak of Sumeru

51he saw a body made of gold,
adorned with gems like the peak of Sumeru.14

দেখি' অতি হৃষ্ট মন তনু পুলকিত ।
দেখিয়া সকল লোক হৈল চমকিত ॥ ৫২ ॥

dekhi' ati hṛṣṭa mana tanu pulakita |
dekhiẏā sakala loka haila camakita || 52 ||

dekhi — seeing; ati hrishta mana — his heart greatly rejoiced; tanu pulakita — his body thrilled; dekhiya sakala loka — seeing this, all the people; haila chamakita — were amazed

52Seeing it, he rejoiced at heart, his body thrilled,
and all the people, seeing it, were amazed.

হলায়ুধ-বেশে নাচে তিন-লোক-নাথ ।
সকল ভকত মেলি' নাচে তার সাথ ॥ ৫৩ ॥

halāẏudha-beśe nāce tina-loka-nātha |
sakala bhakata meli' nāce tāra sātha || 53 ||

halayudha-beshe — in the guise of Halayudha; nache tina-loka-natha — the Lord of the three worlds dances; sakala bhakata meli — all the devotees together; nache tara satha — dance with Him

53In the form of Halayudha the Lord of the three worlds dances,
and all the devotees together dance with Him.

অন্তরীক্ষে দেবগণ হরষিত-মনে ।
সন্তোষ-হৃদয়ে গেল নিজ নিজ স্থানে ॥ ৫৪ ॥

antarīkṣe debagaṇa haraṣita-mane |
santoṣa-hṛdaẏe gela nija nija sthāne || 54 ||

antarikshe devagana — the gods in the sky; harashita-mane — rejoicing at heart; santosha-hridaye — with contented hearts; gela nija nija sthane — went to their own abodes

54The gods in the sky, rejoicing at heart,
went back content to their own abodes.

এইমনে গোঙাইয়া সব দিবানিশি ।
সুরনদী-স্নানে প্রভু যায় হাসি' হাসি' ॥ ৫৫ ॥

eimane goṅāiẏā saba dibāniśi |
suranadī-snāne prabhu yāẏa hāsi' hāsi' || 55 ||

ei-mane — thus; gongaiya saba diva-nishi — having spent all the day and night; suranadi-snane — to bathe in the heavenly river; prabhu yaya hasi hasi — the Lord goes smiling

55Thus, having spent the whole day and night,
the Lord, smiling, goes to bathe in the heavenly river.

সকল বৈষ্ণবগণ করি' এক-মেলে ।
করয়ে মজ্জন স্নান সুরনদী-জলে ॥ ৫৬ ॥

sakala baiṣṇabagaṇa kari' eka-mele |
karaẏe majjana snāna suranadī-jale || 56 ||

sakala vaishnava-gana — all the Vaishnavas; kari eka-mele — gathering together; karaye majjana snana — dip and bathe; suranadi-jale — in the waters of the heavenly river

56All the Vaishnavas together
dip and bathe in the waters of the heavenly river.

নিজজন-সঙ্গে পহুঁ হাস-পরিহাসে ।
কৌতুকে করয়ে ক্রীড়া তা-সভার রসে ॥ ৫৭ ॥

nijajana-saṅge pahuṁ hāsa-parihāse |
kautuke karaẏe krīṛā tā-sabhāra rase || 57 ||

nijajana-sange — with His own; pahu hasa-parihase — the Lord laughs and jests; kautuke karaye krida — plays merrily; ta-sabhara rase — in delight of their company

57The Lord laughs and jests with His own
and plays merrily, delighting in their company.

স্নান সমাপিয়া প্রভু উঠিল সত্বর ।
প্রভু নমস্করি' সভে গেলা নিজ ঘর ॥ ৫৮ ॥

snāna samāpiẏā prabhu uṭhila satbara |
prabhu namaskari' sabhe gelā nija ghara || 58 ||

snana samapiya — finishing the bath; prabhu uthila satvara — the Lord quickly came out; prabhu namaskari — bowing to the Lord; sabhe gela nija ghara — all went to their homes

58Finishing His bath, the Lord quickly came out [of the water];
all bowed to the Lord and went to their homes.

নিজালয় গিয়া প্রভু আছে মহাসুখে ।
প্রভাতে আইলা সভে প্রভুর সম্মুখে ॥ ৫৯ ॥

nijālaẏa giẏā prabhu āche mahāsukhe |
prabhāte āilā sabhe prabhura sammukhe || 59 ||

nijalaya giya — going home; prabhu achhe maha-sukhe — the Lord remains in great happiness; prabhate aila sabhe — in the morning all came; prabhura sammukhe — before the Lord

59The Lord, going home, remains in great happiness;
in the morning all came before the Lord.

কহিল ত মহাপ্রভু শুন এক বাণী ।
গদগদ কহিতে বেকত আধখানি ॥ ৬০ ॥

kahila ta mahāprabhu śuna eka bāṇī |
gadagada kahite bekata ādhakhāni || 60 ||

kahila ta mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu said; shuna eka vani — hear one word; gadgada kahite — speaking with a choked voice; bekata adhakhani — only half was distinct

60And Mahaprabhu said: "Hear one word" —
but His voice choked, and only half was distinct:

বরাহ-ঠাকুর মোরে আলিঙ্গন দিল ।
হলায়ুধ মোর হিয়া প্রবেশ করিল ॥ ৬১ ॥

barāha-ṭhākura more āliṅgana dila |
halāẏudha mora hiẏā prabeśa karila || 61 ||

baraha-thakura — Lord Varaha; more alingana dila — embraced Me; halayudha — Halayudha; mora hiya pravesha karila — entered My heart

61"Lord Varaha embraced Me,
Halayudha entered My heart.

নয়ানে অঞ্জন মোর মুরলীবদন ।
কহিল অমৃত-কথা শুন নিজজন ॥ ৬২ ॥

naẏāne añjana mora muralībadana |
kahila amṛta-kathā śuna nijajana || 62 ||

nayane anjana mora — the collyrium of My eyes; murali-vadana — He with the flute at His lips; kahila amrita-katha — He told a nectarean story; shuna nijajana — hear, His own

62He who holds the flute to His lips has become the collyrium of My eyes."15
Thus He told a nectarean story — hear, His own!

কহিল ত মহাপ্রভু শ্রীবাস দেখিয়া ।
মোর বাঁশী দেহ চাহে শ্রীহস্ত পাতিয়া ॥ ৬৩ ॥

kahila ta mahāprabhu śrībāsa dekhiẏā |
mora bāṁśī deha cāhe śrīhasta pātiẏā || 63 ||

kahila ta mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu said; shrivasa dekhiya — seeing Srivasa; mora banshi deha — give My flute; chahe shri-hasta patiya — He asks, holding out His divine hand

63Seeing Srivasa, Mahaprabhu said:
"Give Me My flute!" — and holds out His divine hand.

তবে সেই শ্রীনিবাস-পণ্ডিত ঠাকুর ।
কহিল তাহারে তেঁহ ভক্ত সুচতুর ॥ ৬৪ ॥

tabe sei śrīnibāsa-paṇḍita ṭhākura |
kahila tāhāre teṁha bhakta sucatura || 64 ||

tabe sei shrinivasa-pandita thakura — then Srinivasa Pandita Thakura; kahila tahare — answered Him; tenha bhakta suchatura — he, a clever devotee

64Then Srinivasa Pandita Thakura,
a clever devotee, answered Him:

শুন শুন মহাপ্রভু এই তোর ঘরে ।
রাখিল ভীষ্মক-কন্যা মুরলী তোমারে ॥ ৬৫ ॥

śuna śuna mahāprabhu ei tora ghare |
rākhila bhīṣmaka-kanyā muralī tomāre || 65 ||

shuna shuna mahaprabhu — listen, listen, Mahaprabhu; ei tora ghare — here in Your house; rakhila bhishmaka-kanya — Bhishmaka's daughter has kept; murali tomare — the flute for You

65"Listen, listen, Mahaprabhu: here, in Your house,
the daughter of Bhishmaka keeps Your flute for You.16

কপাট লাগিল রাত্রে ঘরের দুয়ারে ।
এখনি পাইবা বাঁশী কহিল তোমারে ॥ ৬৬ ॥

kapāṭa lāgila rātre gharera duẏāre |
ekhani pāibā bāṁśī kahila tomāre || 66 ||

kapata lagila ratre — the door-leaves were shut at night; gharera duyare — at the doors of the house; ekhani paiba banshi — You will get the flute at once; kahila tomare — I tell You

66At night the doors of the house were locked —
You will get the flute at once, I tell You."

এইমতে ক্ষণে ক্ষণে আনন্দ-কৌতুক ।
নদিয়া-বিহার এই বড় অপরূপ ॥ ৬৭ ॥

eimate kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ānanda-kautuka |
nadiẏā-bihāra ei baṛa aparūpa || 67 ||

ei-mate — thus; kshane kshane — every moment; ananda-kautuka — joy and merriment; nadiya-vihara ei — these pastimes in Nadia; bada aparupa — most wondrous

67Thus every moment there is joy and merriment:
most wondrous are these pastimes in Nadia.

যে জানে কৃষ্ণরস সে জানে মরম ।
নদিয়া-বিহার-কথা এই বড় ধন ॥ ৬৮ ॥

ye jāne kṛṣṇarasa se jāne marama |
nadiẏā-bihāra-kathā ei baṛa dhana || 68 ||

ye jane krishna-rasa — whoever knows Krishna's rasa; se jane marama — knows the essence; nadiya-vihara-katha — the story of the pastimes in Nadia; ei bada dhana — is a great treasure

68Whoever knows the rasa of Krishna knows their essence:
the story of the pastimes in Nadia is a great treasure.

যে না জানে তারে মুঞি করিয়ে মিনতি ।
হেলা না করিহ দেহ গোরাগুণে মতি ॥ ৬৯ ॥

ye nā jāne tāre muñi kariẏe minati |
helā nā kariha deha gorāguṇe mati || 69 ||

ye na jane — those who do not know; tare munni kariye minati — I implore them; hela na kariha — do not neglect; deha gora-gune mati — turn your minds to Gora's qualities

69And those who do not know — I implore them:
do not neglect it, turn your minds to Gora's qualities.

মন দিয়া চাহ ভাই কি আছে ইহাতে ।
ত্রিজগত-নাথ কৃষ্ণ লাগি' পাবে হাথে ॥ ৭০ ॥

mana diẏā cāha bhāi ki āche ihāte |
trijagata-nātha kṛṣṇa lāgi' pābe hāthe || 70 ||

mana diya chaha bhai — look with your heart, brothers; ki achhe ihate — what is in this; trijagata-natha krishna — Krishna, Lord of the three worlds; lagi pabe hathe — you will get into your hands

70Consider with your heart, brothers, what lies in this:
you will get into your hands Krishna, the Lord of the three worlds.

না ভজিলে নাহি নাহি নাহিক নিস্তার ।
এ লোচন দাস ইহা বোলে বারবার ॥ ৭১ ॥

nā bhajile nāhi nāhi nāhika nistāra |
e locana dāsa ihā bole bārabāra || 71 ||

na bhajile — without serving; nahi nahi nahika nistara — there is no, no, no deliverance; e lochana dasa — this Lochana Dasa; iha bole barabara — says this again and again

71Without serving [Him] there is no, no, no deliverance —
so says Lochana Dasa again and again.

✦

Notes

  1. Vv. 45–69 — cf. Murari 2.13.18–23; Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 17. The kirtana in Srivasa's house was held behind closed doors, and outsiders were not admitted.
  2. Tearing the sacred thread is the sign of a curse pronounced by an angry brahmana.
  3. "Outside samsara" means one who has renounced the world, a sannyasi; the Lord Himself wished to take sannyasa, so the curse is a blessing for Him (cf. Murari 2.13.21–22). The brahmana, coming to his senses, himself foretells the Lord's sannyasa and its fruit: the disputants and logicians who did not honour Him as a householder will bow before the sannyasi and receive prema (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 17).
  4. This section is not in Bhaktisiddhanta's edition (1922); it is translated from Haridasa Shastri's edition (1983), where it stands without a heading of its own (only with the indication "যথা রাগ" and a fresh numbering, vv. 1–22) right after the story of the brahmana's curse (vv. 45–69); the heading is ours. The 1903 edition lacks it. Shachi, full of maternal love (vatsalya), fears for her son as any mother would; the Lord consoles her.
  5. Consoling His mother, the Lord says that a curse without an offence will not take effect; but He Himself, as said above (vv. 56, 64), accepted this curse as a blessing, since it coincided with His wish to take sannyasa (see note 3). Then (vv. 69+19 — 69+20) the Lord, playing the role of a devotee, Himself worships Krishna and the tulasi, teaching this to others.
  6. This summary concerns pastimes told in the next portion (the bhava of Varaha, the sankirtana, the play in Chandrashekhara's house and so on); the pastimes in the bhava of Balarama with which the section begins (vv. 1–58) are already described in the summary of the previous section (en/32). The OCR of the summary is badly garbled; gaps are filled by sense and from the table of contents in the edition's preface ("the Lord's bhava of Varaha, the order to Advaita Acharya and other devotees about sankirtana and preaching, the singing of the gopis' qualities in the bhava of a gopi, the visit to Chandrashekhara's house, Srivasa's bhava of Narada, the glorification of Gadadhara and the revelation that he is Radhika, the arrival of Thakura Haridasa, the bliss of sankirtana, the Lord's bhava of majesty, the distribution of the prema of service in the form of Lakshmi, and finally the bhava of Ishvara").
  7. Halayudha ("armed with the plough"), Haladhara and Baladeva are Balarama. The form and bhava of Balarama that Gaura reveals are His own: Balarama is the first manifestation of Krishna Himself. Cf. Murari 2.14.
  8. So in Bhaktisiddhanta's edition ("অদ্বৈত-মুরারির স্থানে"; the OCR is not entirely clear); the 1983 edition has "to Advaita Acharya", Murari (2.14.4) the house of Murari; Bhaktisiddhanta's summary, the house of Advaita Acharya.
  9. Balarama loves the intoxicating drink varuni; the Lord in His bhava drinks water as honey (cf. Murari 2.14.5). This is not worldly intoxication but rapture in prema (cf. en/28, note 12).
  10. Cf. Murari 2.14.7: "I am not that Krishna whom it is enough to please with words."
  11. Gadadhara Pandita is, in the Gaudiya Vaishnava understanding, Sri Radha (en/25, note 7), the inner (antaranga) shakti of the Lord; hence all His bhavas are known to him. "Gadai's Gauranga" means "Gadadhara's Gauranga".
  12. Acharyaratna is Chandrashekhara Acharya. Vv. 20–38 — cf. Murari 2.14.10–15.
  13. Vv. 43–54 — cf. Murari 2.14.17–22. Balarama's divine varuni is no worldly wine; its fragrance is the sign of the presence of Balarama and His companions, whom Sri Rama Pandita, Srivasa's brother, sees.
  14. In Murari (2.14.20) Vanamali sees on the ground Balarama's golden club, Saunanda. Whether this is the same Vanamali as in en/31 (v. 6 of the section) is not stated.
  15. That is, the Lord ceaselessly beholds Krishna with the flute. Cf. Murari 2.15.1: the Lord tells of the vision of Varaha and Halayudha and asks for His flute.
  16. The daughter of Bhishmaka is Rukmini; thus Srivasa jokingly refers to the Lord's wife, Vishnupriya. (According to the Gaura-ganoddesha-dipika, Rukmini appeared in Gaura-lila as Lakshmipriya, and Vishnupriya is Bhu-shakti.)
